hub.headline: Mesa is an open-source library that implements OpenGL and other graphics APIs.
hub.next: Point readers to the Mesa maintainers and record a repeatable local build from the official build documentation.
hub.what_it_was: Mesa provides open-source implementations of OpenGL, OpenGL ES, Vulkan, OpenCL and more. It runs on Linux and BSD systems. The archive tracks it as part of OpenGL's history and as a dependency for other engines.
hub.what_survives: Mesa is alive. Its upstream Git repository is hosted on freedesktop.org and can be cloned anonymously; the core library is MIT licensed, and some components carry their own licences. Official documentation covers building with Meson.

name: Mesa
summary: Public records now track Mesa's official API summary, upstream freedesktop.org repository documentation, and license posture.
